build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that generates ball and obstacle bar physics scenarios
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable width and horizontal position in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned above an obstacle bar in the physics scene
define_spatial_relationship: define a touching spatial relationship between the ball and obstacle bar objects
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations using SkipTemplateParams when ball lands on obstacle
